Video.summary: Experience the high-stakes intensity of a "Battle for the Bid" at the 2024 DUPR Florida Super Regional in Port Saint Lucie. This match pits the seasoned Kennesaw State Owls against a surprising Georgia Tech squad that is brand new to the tournament scene. Despite Kennesaw entering as the heavy 80% statistical favorite, the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets delivered a stunning wake-up call with a dominant 21–9 victory in Women's Doubles. Now, the Owls must lean on their powerhouse Men’s and Mixed Doubles teams to claw back and keep their championship dreams alive. With a direct invitation to the Collegiate Pickleball Nationals in Dallas on the line, every point is a fight for survival in this premier regional showcase.
